newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daesung Ind to absorb listed affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Daesung Ind to absorb listed affiliate.

text.p: South Korea's Daesung Industrial Co said on Monday it has decided to absorb its affiliate Daesung Resources Co on August 1 to boost management efficiency.
Every 10 shares of Daesung Resources will be exchanged into 16.95 shares of Daesung Industrial, a company statement said.
After the merger, Daesung Industrial's paid-in capital would rise to 25.66 billion won from the current 22 billion, it said.
The plan is subject to approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on May 28, the statement said.
Daesung Industrial sells oil products while Daesung Resources produces limestone for industrial use.
